B0-2_ridge_ole.target_side_compute: one 2x2 pseudoinverse per session plus O(N) per window

endpoint_only_t4_caveat: T4 is fit from endpoint target direction labels, so it supplies a direction/rate anchor but contains no instantaneous speed or within-trial dynamics model.

protocol.lambda_selection: unweighted mean leave-one-source-session-out R2; source sessions only
protocol.output_scale: one zero-intercept isotropic scalar fitted on all source-session post-pool windows
protocol.rate_definition: mean firing rate over the 50-bin (1.0s) causal window
protocol.target_direction_labels_used: only first-50 endpoint target_dir labels to construct T4
